articles.summary: NEW HAVEN, CT, (July 11th, 2025) – Specialty cancer diagnostics company Precipio, Inc. (NASDAQ: PRPO) has entered into an agreement with its largest warrant holder, amending the existing structure from cash exercise of warrants, to a revised structure whereby 100,000 warrants (approximately ⅓) shall be exercised with cash, and the remainder (approximately 200,000 warrants) to be exercised in [...]
articles.title: Precipio Enters Into Agreement With Warrant Holder To Exercise Majority Of Warrants As Cashless
